title: Microsoft 365: Teams Channel Backup
description: A backup and recovery feature that lets you recover team & channel data (like files, messages exchanged over channels) in Microsoft Teams to a previously known good state after accidental changes or security compromises. Supported items include Team, Channels (Standard, Private, Public) and underlying data. Retention period supported is 30 days.
